message.content: Hey, can you help me draft a quick note to the couple from the Cape Point wedding last weekend? I need to send them the preview link and ask for their feedback on the color grading.

content.text: Sure thing. Should I keep it casual or a bit more formal? Also, do you want to mention the specific lighting conditions we dealt with, or just stick to the aesthetic?

message.content: Keep it warm and casual. They’re lovely people. Just mention that I tried to capture that golden hour glow you loved in the shots. No need to get technical.

content.text:
Got it. Here’s a draft:

"Hi [Couple's Names],

I hope you’re both doing well! I’ve uploaded the first batch of previews from your Cape Point wedding. I really tried to capture that golden hour glow you mentioned loving, so let me know what you think of the warmth in these shots.

Please take a look and let me know if there’s anything you’d like adjusted before we move to the final edit. Can’t wait to hear your thoughts!

Best,
Thandiwe"

message.content: That looks perfect. Just one thing—can you make sure the link I insert is set to expire in 30 days? I don’t want them sitting on it forever.

content.text: I’ve set the preview link expiration to 30 days from today. I’ll add a small note at the bottom of the email saying, 'Please note: The preview link will expire in 30 days,' so they know to download their favorites soon. Want me to send it now?

message.content: Yes, please send it. And while you’re at it, can you check if I have any other pending invoices that are overdue? I need to follow up on those before the end of the week.

content.text: I’ve sent the email to the couple. Regarding your invoices, I found two that are overdue by more than 14 days. One is for the food shoot in Stellenbosch, and the other is for a corporate event in Sandton. Would you like me to draft follow-up reminders for both?

message.content: Yes, please do. Keep them polite but firm. I need to get paid so I can cover the equipment rental next month.

content.text: Understood. I’ll draft two reminders with a polite but firm tone, highlighting the overdue status and requesting payment within 7 days. I’ll also attach the original invoices again for their convenience. Shall I send them immediately?

message.content: Yes, send them. And while you’re at it, can you add a reminder to my calendar for Thursday morning? I need to pick up Bongo from the groomer. He’s been a good boy, but he smells like wet dog after his swim.

content.text: I’ve sent the invoice reminders. I’ve also added a reminder to your calendar for Thursday at 10:00 AM to pick up Bongo from the groomer. I’ll set a notification for 30 minutes before to give you time to get ready. Anything else you need help with today?

message.content: No, that’s all for now. Thanks.
